question.problem: What is the trace in the $xy$-plane of the ellipsoid $\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{2}+\frac{{z}^{2}}{2}=1?$
question.worked_solution:
To find the trace in the $xy$-plane, we substitute $z=0$ into the equation of the ellipsoid:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{2}+\frac{{0}^{2}}{2} & =1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{4}+\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{2} & =1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{{2}^{2}}+\frac{(y-1)^{2}}{(\sqrt{2})^{2}} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

This gives us the equation of the ellipse with semi-axes $2$ and $\sqrt{2},$ centered at $(0,1)$ in the $xy$-plane.
